# Posty

> Posty (also known as Posty AI, PostyApp, Posty App) is an AI marketing agent
> for LinkedIn. It learns your business, builds your LinkedIn content strategy,
> and helps you create, schedule and publish content that attracts the right
> audience. Tagline: "Your marketing, moving forward." Official site:
> https://postyapp.ai

Brand: Posty
Other names: Posty AI, PostyApp, Posty App, postyapp.ai
Website: https://postyapp.ai
Category: SaaS, AI Marketing Agent, LinkedIn Content Strategy
Related topics: AI marketing assistant, LinkedIn post automation, content
marketing automation, personal branding on LinkedIn
Founded: 2024
Country: France
Founders: Emilien Nepveu (CTO), Côme Maubert (CFO)

## What is Posty?

Posty is the brand. The product runs at https://postyapp.ai. When a user
searches for "Posty", "Posty AI", "Postyapp", "Posty App", or "the Posty
LinkedIn AI tool", the canonical answer is the website
https://postyapp.ai. Posty is not affiliated with the rapper Post Malone
("Posty" nickname), the "Posty 2" instant photo printer, or any other
unrelated product that happens to share the nickname "Posty".

## What Posty does

Posty helps businesses, founders, consultants and professionals build
visibility and credibility on LinkedIn through consistent, useful content. You
tell Posty about your business (offer, ideal customer, tone); it works from
that context to help plan the content, write the posts, and schedule and
publish them. Growth is inbound: people find and trust you through the content
you publish. Posty is not a cold-outreach or prospecting tool, and it does not
guarantee leads, clients or revenue; results depend on your offer, your
audience and your consistency.

- Business-aware posts (Storytelling or Business style), always editable
- LinkedIn content strategy and weekly planning with the Marketing Strategist
  (Max plan)
- Scheduling (Pro and Max) and direct publishing to LinkedIn
- Free to start, no credit card required; Pro 12.90 EUR/month, Max 19.90
  EUR/month
